steps.assistant_text: Retrospective verified source port onto frozen upstream. Independent native C, original USO identities, both raw modes, full ROM, six strict code-block payloads and no exact/raw/partial regression pass. Canonical and remote branches untouched.

analysis.purpose: Counts 0xFFFC sentinel cells among nine table-selected grid positions, then updates a fraction with immediate decreases and increases smoothed by double 0.6. The sentinel's game meaning remains unknown.
analysis.observed_abi: a0 points to the object. On exit, v0 contains the count and f0 retains count/9. The function preserves s0 using an 8-byte frame and makes no calls. The provisional void declaration reproduces the original instructions; the original formal return declaration remains unknown.
evidence: Normal and NON_MATCHING C each produce 600 bytes with SHA256 963dcea85192f65ce1f00c46abb12fa4013f4b672255b81dc9149ced0c6d8a15, identical to the immutable expected function.
Typed signed-halfword offset fields and product-first index grouping resolved the five remaining addu operand swaps.
Object fields: +0xCC float fraction, +0xD0/+0xD4 integer coordinates, +0xD8 metadata pointer. Metadata +0xB8/+0xBC supply stride and extent.
External data import import_8005C348 supplies a context pointer at +0x240. Context +0x148 points to a buffer whose +0xF0 field supplies unsigned-halfword cells.
Offset pairs occupy four bytes. Reads occur only when 0 < index < stride*extent. Immutable USO RoData+0x148 contains double 0.6.
Inspected AE1C, B274, B420, B498 and A7F8. AE1C and B274 corroborate the derived fields; five users of that layout were not established.
Assembly contains no jal or jalr. Supplied and local graphs report callers=[], calls=[] and unresolved_calls=[]; missing incoming edges remain a coverage limitation.
make -j2 verify verify-blocks passed. ROM MD5 is fa27089c425dbab99f19245c5c997613, and cmp confirms identity with baserom.
Baseline comparison found no byte changes in other normal unit functions and no regressions among 215 previously raw-exact functions. Other NON_MATCHING instruction listings also remain unchanged.
Local objdiff reports 99.833336% because of relocation-name differences; raw instruction bytes are fully identical. Only src/game_uso/game_uso.c changed.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
hypotheses: The routine measures local sentinel-cell coverage; its object class and gameplay role are not established.
A void interface is plausible, but live return registers and absent callers do not prove its original declaration.
unknowns: Original formal return declaration, complete object-class identity and sentinel meaning.
Ghidra list_project_binaries was denied because approval was required under a never-approval policy.
Canonical episode creation and integration remain coordinator-owned; no commit or publication was performed.

The surrounding host definition preserves compiler/RoData context; the required independently compiled C implementation is src/match_imports/game_uso_func_0000B4B8.c. This is not a proof of original source spelling or whole-program portable source.

limitations: Indirect calls and missing recovered relocations stay unresolved; alias value zero is not an identity.
Observed indirect calls prove possible executed targets only; preserve indirect C dispatch and other unknown runtime targets.
